facts.claim: The Lodge St. John in Secunderabad was founded in 1822.
facts.quote: Founded as it was in 1822 it possesses an almost unbroken record of minutes

facts.claim: The Lodge St. John had gaps in its minutes when it lacked enough members to conduct ceremonies.
facts.quote: gaps only occurring at such times as the Lodge unfortunately had insufficient members to conduct its ceremonies

facts.claim: The Lodge St. John was temporarily unable to conduct ceremonies because many of its officers were called to serve elsewhere.
facts.quote: a sudden call to its military brethren to serve their Sovereign elsewhere, which at one fell sweep would rob the Lodge of its Officers and Master
